tasks.title: Create provider and consumer models
tasks.instructions:
Create both the provider and consumer models:

```bash
juju add-model lab-cmr-provider
juju add-model lab-cmr-consumer
```

Verify that both models are listed:

```bash
juju models
```
tasks.solution:
```bash
juju add-model lab-cmr-provider
juju add-model lab-cmr-consumer
```

tasks.title: Deploy provider application and create offer
tasks.instructions:
Deploy `haproxy` named `provider-app` into `lab-cmr-provider` and offer its `reverseproxy` endpoint:

```bash
juju deploy haproxy provider-app --channel latest/stable -m lab-cmr-provider
juju offer -m lab-cmr-provider provider-app:reverseproxy proxy-offer
```

Verify that the offer is listed:

```bash
juju offers
```
hints: Deploy to model with `-m lab-cmr-provider` and offer with `juju offer -m lab-cmr-provider provider-app:reverseproxy proxy-offer`.

tasks.title: Deploy consumer and integrate cross-model offer
tasks.instructions:
Deploy `haproxy` named `consumer-app` into `lab-cmr-consumer` and integrate with the offer:

```bash
juju deploy haproxy consumer-app --channel latest/stable -m lab-cmr-consumer
juju integrate -m lab-cmr-consumer consumer-app:website admin/lab-cmr-provider.proxy-offer
```

Verify the cross-model integration:

```bash
juju status -m lab-cmr-consumer
```
tasks.solution:
```bash
juju deploy haproxy consumer-app --channel latest/stable -m lab-cmr-consumer
juju integrate -m lab-cmr-consumer consumer-app:website admin/lab-cmr-provider.proxy-offer
```
